en.title: Nearest Store for Each House
en.description:
Houses and stores lie on a one-dimensional number line. For each house, return the position of the nearest store; if the distances tie, return the smaller position. Duplicate positions are allowed, and the results are output in the original order of the houses.

The input format, examples, and test data are compiled and written by CSWork.
en.input: The first line contains n m (1..100000); the second line contains n house positions, and the third line contains m store positions; all positions are integers in 0..10⁹.
en.output: Output the answer as described; multiple results are separated by spaces, in order.
en.explanation: The example inputs and outputs follow the rules above directly; see the solution for the full algorithm.
hints: Sort the store positions. Binary search for each house's insertion point; only the adjacent stores on the left and right need to be compared.
